FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Au revoir, Monsieur.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hi, Kamau!
   B. Goodbye, Sir.
   C. Yes, I am fine.
   D. Pleased to meet you!

2. In the word salut, which letter is silent? (1 mark)
   A. l
   B. t
   C. u
   D. s

3. Which little word goes with 'fille' (the girl)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

4. What does 'C'est mon père.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. Who is it?
   C. Here is my family.
   D. Here is my grandmother.

5. Fill in: Le sac est ______ la chambre. (in) (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. dans
   C. sur
   D. derrière

6. Which little word goes with 'chat' (the cat)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. la
   D. le

7. Read: Salut ! Je m'appelle Kamau. J'ai dix ans. Le samedi, je joue au football. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église avec ma famille. Question: Who does he go to church with on Sunday? (1 mark)
   A. his teacher
   B. his cat
   C. his family
   D. nobody

8. Read: Salut ! Je m'appelle Kamau. J'ai dix ans. Le samedi, je joue au football. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église avec ma famille. Question: How old is Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. twelve
   B. eleven
   C. nine
   D. ten

9. What does 'Tu as quel âge ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. How old are you?
   B. Thank you very much!
   C. I am nine years old.
   D. My birthday is on 12 May.

10. What does 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My birthday is on 12 May.
   B. Here is a present for you.
   C. Happy birthday!
   D. I am nine years old.

11. What does 'J'aime le lait.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. They are mangoes.
   B. I drink a juice.
   C. It is good for your health.
   D. I like milk.

12. What does 'Le matin, je mange du pain.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is not good for your health.
   B. In the morning, I eat bread.
   C. It is good for your health.
   D. They are mangoes.

13. Read: Le matin, je mange du pain et je bois du thé. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots. Le soir, je mange du poisson. Question: What does the speaker eat at midday? (1 mark)
   A. a banana
   B. rice and beans
   C. bread
   D. fish

14. Which little word goes with 'jambe' (the leg)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

15. Read: Voici Amina. Elle a dix ans. Elle est grande. Elle a les cheveux noirs et longs. Elle a deux grands yeux. Question: Is Amina tall or short? (1 mark)
   A. short
   B. old
   C. tall
   D. very small

16. What does 'Elle a les cheveux longs.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. He is tall.
   B. Touch your nose!
   C. She is short.
   D. She has long hair.

17. What does 'Il y a un orage.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I stay in the house.
   B. It is sunny.
   C. There is a storm.
   D. It is cold.

18. Which little word goes with 'vent' (the wind)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. le
   D. l'

19. What does 'Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Go straight ahead.
   B. Turn right.
   C. Where is the key?
   D. Excuse me, where is the school?

20. Read: Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télé. Le tapis est devant le canapé. Le chat est sous la table. Question: Where is the cat? (1 mark)
   A. under the table
   B. on the sofa
   C. behind the door
   D. in front of the sofa

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: 'Qu'est-ce que c'est ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into English: 'C'est bon pour la santé.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Translate into English: 'J'ai dix doigts.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

24. Translate into English: 'J'ai un nez.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

25. Translate into English: 'C'est le premier janvier.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into English: 'Elle a les cheveux noirs.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Translate into English: 'Je reste dans la maison.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Translate into English: 'Le samedi, je joue.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Translate into English: 'Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Translate into English: 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

31. Translate into English: 'Bonjour, Amina !' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Goodbye, Sir.
   Au revoir, Monsieur. means Goodbye, Sir.

2. B — t
   The final t is silent in salut.

3. B — la
   fille is feminine, so we say la fille.

4. A — This is my father.
   C'est mon père. means This is my father.

5. B — dans
   Dans means in.

6. D — le
   chat is masculine, so we say le chat.

7. C — his family
   Avec ma famille means with my family.

8. D — ten
   J'ai dix ans.

9. A — How old are you?
   Tu as quel âge ? means How old are you?

10. A — My birthday is on 12 May.
   Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai. means My birthday is on 12 May.

11. D — I like milk.
   J'aime le lait. means I like milk.

12. B — In the morning, I eat bread.
   Le matin, je mange du pain. means In the morning, I eat bread.

13. B — rice and beans
   Du riz et des haricots.

14. B — la
   jambe is feminine, so we say la jambe.

15. C — tall
   Elle est grande.

16. D — She has long hair.
   Elle a les cheveux longs. means She has long hair.

17. C — There is a storm.
   Il y a un orage. means There is a storm.

18. C — le
   vent is masculine, so we say le vent.

19. D — Excuse me, where is the school?
   Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? means Excuse me, where is the school?

20. A — under the table
   Le chat est sous la table.
